items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee only responds with 'Um-hm' to the interviewer's statements about Clare Fischer's work and usage by other artists, indicating awareness but no direct personal or professional interaction described.

ctx.x: I’d say so, and also the one alto sticks out. There's not something to blend it with, in fact if I have six saxophones, I’ll use three altos, three, two, and one is a wonderful sound.
Have you heard the things Clare Fischer did for six saxes with two altos, two tenors, baritone and a bass on the bottom?
